data.title: Logbook order for vehicle BF-MU 412
data.summary: The Kreis Beispielförde traffic department ordered on 29 September 2026 that you keep a vehicle logbook (Fahrtenbuch) for six months for vehicle BF-MU 412. The driver could not be identified after a traffic offence on 14 July 2026.
data.explanation: The authority orders you to keep a logbook recording who drives your vehicle BF-MU 412 for six months. The order starts once the decision becomes final (Bestandskraft), meaning after the objection period ends without an objection. You may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the office; the app shows the deadline. If you do nothing, the order becomes binding. Consider getting advice if you want to challenge it.

items.title: Object to the logbook order
items.action: File an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person with Kreis Beispielförde if you want to challenge the order.
items.consequence: Without an objection the order becomes final and the logbook duty starts.

date.text: binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist

items.quote: Der Widerspruch muss binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Beispielförde, Kreishaus, Förder Straße 3, 24103 Beispielförde, erhoben werden.
